notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/MaterialChanger entry, which took the same route.

dBgPc is dBgPi's non-polymorphic base (the five-word SurfaceInfo record at +0x04): the TU is one ~dBgPc() and one dBgPc(), which emit the whole ABI surface -- D2,D1 destructor variants and C1,C2 constructor variants -- with C1/C2 byte-identical because a non-polymorphic base stores no vptr.

No _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS emit: the class is non-polymorphic, so there is no key function and no RTTI machinery. The cartridge's _ZTI5dBgPc record, where it exists, is emitted by the derived class's TU as base-info, not here.

The emitted-object section order places the C1/C2 pair ahead of the D2/D1 pair; dsd's per-symbol enrollment, not section order, maps each variant to its address, so the verifier's ordinal-pair advisory (1,2) is expected, per the pilot report's destructor-group note.
